messages:
jamal: opened PR #317 to tidy the Quickstart: consolidate hello app, clarify auth var name, add tiny Docker example, and inject a short Go snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/317
marie: nice. can we keep the Python quick example to one file and note SDK compatibility (v7+ uses REDWOOD_API_KEY)?
sara: +1 on the env var note. also update examples to show `Authorization: Bearer <key>` rather than older header forms. i'll flag any lingering `API_KEY` references in examples.
jamal: good call. i'll grep and replace and add a brief compatibility note under "Before you start".
docs-bot: build preview queued for PR #317 1:45 UTC
alex: tiny UX suggestions after a quick scan: 1) move Docker snippet earlier near the deploy paragraph, 2) add one-line CORS hint for local dev (chrome can block localhost requests).
marie: added a Go snippet in the PR comments consistent with new client API: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{Prompt: "hi"})
```
jamal: thanks marie. can you also author the single-file Python example? i'll place it in the minimal quickstart section.
marie: pushed Python single-file example to the branch: ```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
print(client.generate("Hello from Redwood"))
```

jamal: i must have left an outdated cross-ref. fixing links now.
jamal: pushed link fix, updated to /examples/quickstart/hello.md and removed old-snippets reference.
docs-bot: preview ready 1:58 UTC 1: https://deploy-preview-317.docs.redwood.ai/preview (diff: consolidated quickstart, auth note, Docker, Go/Python snippets)
sara: quick wording tweak: change "set your key" to "export REDWOOD_API_KEY in your shell" so it's explicit for new devs. also add a short note about Windows PowerShell vs bash.
alex: LGTM after those two micro copy edits. please squash doc commits into one commit for cleaner git history.
jamal: will squash on merge. filing a follow-up issue for expanded troubleshooting and CORS/Windows tips (ISSUE #91).

jamal: merged PR #317 1:03 UTC. closing thread f389
